title: matelea purpurea
intro: Matelea purpurea, commonly known as the Purple Coral Milk Flower or Purple Coral Vine, is a flowering plant species in the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been found to have several health benefits, including its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Matelea purpurea include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents present in Matelea purpurea include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
